mapper.select: SELECT F.FRAGMENT_NO AS fragmentNo, F.UID AS uid, STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', F.REG_DATE) AS regDate, F.TOPIC_NO AS topicNo, T.NAME AS topicName, T.IMOGI AS imogi, F.USER_NO AS userNo, U.NICKNAME AS userNickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS userProfileUrl, F.CONTENT AS content FROM MB_FRAGMENT F INNER JOIN MB_TOPIC T ON T.TOPIC_NO = F.TOPIC_NO INNER JOIN MB_USER U ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE F.FRAGMENT_NO = #{fragmentNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS SET IS_DELETED = #{deleted}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS WHERE 1=1 AND IS_DELETED = 1 AND UPDATE_DATE < DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '-' || ${day} || ' days')
